problems.problem: The company needs stronger systems to detect harmful model behavior and prevent misuse or disallowed use.
evidence: This role will focus on building systems to detect unwanted model behaviors and prevent disallowed use of models.
As a software engineer on the Safeguards team, you will work to monitor models, prevent misuse, and ensure user well-being.
problems.rationale: These statements indicate a need for technical mechanisms that identify unsafe behavior and block abusive or prohibited model usage.

problems.problem: The company needs foundational infrastructure for measuring, evaluating, and managing safeguards-related data.
evidence: Develop the foundational systems which power Safeguards, including infrastructure for data storage and management, metric and evaluation systems, and tooling for human and agentic review.
problems.rationale: The emphasis on storage, metrics, evaluations, and review tooling shows that Safeguards needs a stronger underlying measurement and data infrastructure.

problems.problem: The company needs safeguards systems that are reliable and operationally efficient at scale, with less dependence on manual oversight.
evidence: Ensure the day-to-day running of Safeguards systems and hold a high operational bar which serves both safety and customers while reducing the amount of human intervention and oversight required.
Build robust and reliable multi-layered defenses for real-time improvement of safety mechanisms that work at scale
problems.rationale: These requirements imply that existing or planned safeguards must become more dependable, scalable, and automated in day-to-day operation.

problems.problem: The company needs layered, real-time defenses that can continuously improve against emerging safety risks.
evidence: Build robust and reliable multi-layered defenses for real-time improvement of safety mechanisms that work at scale
problems.rationale: The requirement for multi-layered defenses and real-time improvement indicates an ongoing need to adapt safeguards as risks and model behavior change.

problems.problem: The company needs custom review and operations tooling that supports both human teams and agentic systems.
evidence: Develop the foundational systems which power Safeguards, including infrastructure for data storage and management, metric and evaluation systems, and tooling for human and agentic review.
Have worked closely with operational teams to build custom internal tooling
problems.rationale: These statements show a need to equip reviewers and operational teams with purpose-built tools for investigating and acting on safety issues.
